title: Observation
description: A measurement event: what was true of one subject over one period, recorded by one engine. Specified in architecture/observation-object.md. See adr/0005-observation-as-a-contract.md.

schema_version.description: Semver of the Observation specification this object conforms to.

observation_id.description: Globally unique identifier. 'obs_' followed by a 26-character ULID.

source.description: The engine that recorded this measurement. JARVIS is never a source.

source_version.description: Semver of the engine build. Required for reproducibility.

domain.description: Subdomain measured. An Observation has no category.

subject.description: What was measured, where the domain alone is not specific enough.

summary.description: What was measured. Factual and declarative, never causal.

metrics.description: Metrics measured together, of one subject over one period.

source_ref.description: Provenance: the query, report, or system this came from.

observed_at.description: When the measurement was taken. Never earlier than period_end.

period_start.description: Start of the measured period. Required alongside period_end.

period_end.description: End of the measured period. Required alongside period_start.

supersedes.description: The observation_id this corrects. Must share source and domain.
